title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 38. Calls for reinforced, evidence-based action to protect people from environmental cancer risk factors, including air, water and soil pollution, certain kinds of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), hazardous and radioactive substances, UV exposure and second-hand smoke, supported by improved data, EU monitoring, and the effective implementation of the new EU strategic framework for health and safety at work post-2027;
